sources.title: zils — Teach AI to make decisions your way.
sources.snippet: Zils Zils Teach AI to make decisions your way. Show Zils examples with the right answers. It trains a small model your app can use to sort requests, flag problems, or score matches.

sources.title: qhoenix/zils-lite-decision · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Built by LoRA fine-tuning a uniform weight average of vllm-sr/d3-lite, Maincode/Matilda-Decision-v1-Edge and cribl-ai/cribl-decision-2-0.8B (all Apache-2.0) on public decision-style data (train splits of public classification/NLI/QA datasets and resolved public events), then averaging the result 50/50 with that base average.
